y-m-78-12.title: Tinofanira kuisa avhareji nestandard deviation sei kuti zvikanganiso zvive pedyo ne 5%?
y-m-78-12.topic: Kugadzira specification uchishandisa interval inenge 95% yenormal distribution
y-m-78-12.goal: Uchishandisa hunhu hwokuti inenge 95% iri mukati me standard deviation 2 padhuze neavhareji, dudzira mamiriro eavhareji nestandard deviation yemaitiro okugadzira, usarudze imwe pakati pemhinduro dzakati wandei uye utaure njodzi yayo.
y-m-78-12.material: Pafekitori yezvokudya zvidiki, fungidzira kuti huremu (g) hwebhegi rimwe hunotevera normal distribution ine avhareji μ ('mu') nestandard deviation σ ('sigma'). Specification ndi 95 g kana kupfuura uye 107 g kana kushoma, uye bhegi riri kunze kwe specification rakanganisa. Uchishandisa mutemo wokuti inenge 95% yemabhegi iri mukati me standard deviation 2 yeavhareji (μ−2σ kusvika μ+2σ), tinotora kuti kuti zvikanganiso zvive inenge 5% kana shoma, interval iyi inofanira kuva mukati me specification.

y-m-78-01.title: Ma box plots maviri: tinogona kutaura kuti A i inokurumidza here?
y-m-78-01.topic: Kuenzanisa mapoka maviri nema box plots: kupindirana nezvinogona kuverengwa
y-m-78-01.goal: Siyanisa zvinogona nezvisingagone kuverengwa nechokwadi kubva pa box plot, uye utarise pamwe chete musiyano mudiki wema medians, kupindirana kwemabhokisi, nehuwandu hwedata kuti usarudze kuvimba kwekutonga.
y-m-78-01.material:
Mashopu maviri emuno ezvekudya zvidiki, A ne B, akaburitsa nguva dzekutumira (kubva paodha kusvika pakusvika, mumaminetsi) dzemaodha avo ekupedzisira sema box plots. Zvakatsanangurwa mumashoko, ma box plots i anotevera.

| | Minimum | First quartile | Median | Third quartile | Maximum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 15 | 23 | 28 | 38 | 55 |
| B | 20 | 26 | 31 | 40 | 52 |

(First quartile i mutengo apo kota yakadzika inopera, uye third quartile i mutengo apo kota yakakwira inotanga. Bhokisi rinofukidza mitengo iri pakati pe first ne third quartiles, ndiko kuti, hafu yepakati yedata.) Nguva pfupi yekutumira i nani. Munhu anoona nezve app yekutumira anoda kuisa A se 'shopu inokurumidza'.
y-m-78-01.thinking.0: Kuenzanisa musiyano wema medians nehurefu hwebhokisi (kupararira) pamwe chete
y-m-78-01.thinking.1: Kuronga zvinogona nezvisingagone kuzivikanwa kubva pa box plot oga
y-m-78-01.thinking.2: Kutarisa kutonga kwako nekuvimba mushure mekudzidza huwandu hwedata
y-m-78-01.prereq.0: Basa iri ri padanho rekunetsa 'H1' (danho rekutanga rehigh school) mukugoverwa kwekugadzira kwe platform iyi, uye hazvireve kuti Ministry of Education inopa chidzidzo ichi kugiredhi rakati. Fungidzira kuti wakatoziva mapfungwa anodiwa pazasi.
y-m-78-01.prereq.1: Maitiro ekuverenga minimum, first quartile, median, third quartile, ne maximum kubva pa box plot
y-m-78-01.prereq.2: Median i mutengo wepakati kana data rarongwa nehukuru
y-m-78-01.s.s1.prompt: Zvichibva pa box plots oga, tanga watonga kana munhu anoona angaisa A se 'shopu inokurumidza'. Ndeipi inokodzera zvikuru?
y-m-78-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nhamba dzerange apo mabhokisi maviri anopindirana.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.hint.1: Wana musiyano wema medians (maminetsi) nehurefu hwebhokisi (maminetsi) uye uvaenzanise.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.o.a: Median ya A i diki, saka imwe neimwe yemaodha ya A inosvika nekukurumidza kupfuura maodha ya B, pasina kusiyana.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.r.a: Median i mutengo mumwe wepakati. Haienzanisi mitengo yese yemapoka maviri. Maximum ya A ye 55 i hombe kupfuura maximum ya B ye 52.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.o.b: Ma medians anosiyana ne maminetsi 3 uye mabhokisi anopindirana zvakawanda, saka zvakaoma kuzvidaidza musiyano wakajeka.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.r.b: Wakafunga musiyano mudiki wema medians pamwe chete nekupindirana kwehafu yepakati yedata. Pane tsika munzira imwe, asi wakangwarira nehukuru hwemusiyano.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.o.c: Mabhokisi maviri ane hurefu hwakafanana, saka nguva dzekutumira dzemashopu maviri dzakafanana chaizvo.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.r.c: Zvechokwadi kuti hurefu hwemabhokisi (anenge maminetsi 15 ne 14) hwakafanana, asi izvo hazvisimbise chokwadi chekuti ma medians anosiyana ne maminetsi 3. "Zvakafanana chaizvo" zvakasimbawo zvakanyanya.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.o.d: Odha yekutanga yakakurumidza ya B yaiva maminetsi 20, inononoka kupfuura maminetsi 15 ya A, saka odha imwe neimwe ya B inononoka kupfuura chero odha ya A.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.r.d: Kuenzanisa minimum imwe chete hakugone kuenzanisa maodha ese. Hafu yepakati ya A (bhokisi) i maminetsi 23 kusvika 38, saka maodha mazhinji akatora nguva refu kupfuura minimum ya B ye maminetsi 20.
y-m-78-01.s.s1.explain: Mabhokisi maviri anopindirana zvakawanda murange yeanenge maminetsi 26 kusvika 38. Median ya A kuva diki ne maminetsi 3 i mufungo wa 'tsika yekuti A i inokurumidza zvishoma' chete, uye hairevi kuti maodha ese kana mazhinji anokurumidza kuna A.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza zvese zvinogona 'kuzivikanwa' kubva pa box plot iyi oga.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.hint.0: Wana kuti sarudzo imwe neimwe inobva pane imwe ipi yenhamba shanu dze box plot.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana pane sarudzo dzakasanganiswa dzisingagone kutaurwa kubva mumitengo iyoyo oga (huwandu, mamiriro ekunze, nezvimwewo).
y-m-78-01.s.s2.o.a: Kuna A, hafu zvishoma yemaodha yakasvika mukati memaminetsi 28.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.r.a: Wakashandisa zvinoreva median. Mitengo iri pa median kana pasi payo i hafu zvishoma.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.o.b: Kuna B, maodha anopfuura hafu akasvika mukati memaminetsi 30.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.r.b: Kana median ya B i 31, zvinoreva kuti hafu zvishoma yemaodha yakatora maminetsi 31 kana kupfuura. Ipapo maminetsi 30 kana kushoma haagone kupfuura hafu.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.o.c: Ndeipi pa A ne B ine maodha akawanda.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.r.c: Box plot haiti huwandu hwemitengo yedata. Huwandu hunofanira kupiwa zvakaparadzana.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.o.d: Kuna B, anenge kota yemaodha yakatora maminetsi 40 kana kupfuura.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.r.d: Wakashandisa zvinoreva third quartile. Kota yakakwira iri pamutengo uyu kana pamusoro payo.
y-m-78-01.s.s2.explain: Median zvinoreva kuti 'hafu zvishoma iri pamutengo uyu kana pasi pawo', uye third quartile zvinoreva kuti 'anenge kota iri pamutengo uyu kana pamusoro pawo'. Kune rimwe divi, huwandu nenguva chaidzo dzezuva (semuenzaniso, mazuva emvura) i ruzivo rusiri mu box plot.
y-m-78-01.s.s3.prompt: Pane chinhu chitsva chawakadzidza. Ma box plots maviri akaitwa imwe neimwe kubva ku 'maodha 20 ekupedzisira' chete. Kutonga kwako kwekutanga hakuchinji here, kana kuchinja? Nyora chikonzero, uye unyore rudzi rumwe zvishoma rwedata raungada kuziva kuti kutonga kwako kuve kwakasimba.
y-m-78-01.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kutonga kwako kwekutanga nechokwadi chitsva padivi pedivi.
y-m-78-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora mumushoko rimwe kuti huwandu hwedata, maodha 20, hunokanganisa sei kuti unotenda musiyano we maminetsi 3 zvakadini.
y-m-78-01.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kutonga kwangu kwekutanga kwaiva ... nekuti ...
y-m-78-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakabatanidza kutonga kwako kwekutanga nechokwadi chitsva here (kana wakachengeta, sei wakachengeta; kana wakachinja, chii chakachinja)?
y-m-78-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora hwaro hwekutaura kuti A i inokurumidza nehwaro hwekuti sei zvakaoma kutaura nechokwadi here?
y-m-78-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Data rekuwedzera randakakumbira i data rinobatsira kutonga chaizvo (semuenzaniso, maodha akawanda, kupatsanurwa nenguva yezuva) here?
y-m-78-01.s.s3.model.0: Kutonga kwangu kwekutanga kunoramba kwakafanana. Ma medians i A maminetsi 28 ne B maminetsi 31, musiyano we maminetsi 3 chete, uye mabhokisi anopindirana zvakawanda. Zvakare, nemaodha 20 chete, musiyano wakadaro unogona kuva njodzi, saka handigone kutaura nechokwadi kuti A i inokurumidza. Ndinoda kuunganidza maodha akawanda uye ndotarisa.
y-m-78-01.s.s3.model.1: Ndinochinja kutonga kwangu zvishoma. Ndichitarisa ma medians oga, A yaiva nemutemo wekukurumidza, asi nemaodha 20 chete data i shoma, saka kuvimba kwangu kwakadzikira. Ndinoda data remaodha 100 ekupedzisira zvishoma kushopu imwe neimwe nedata renguva yezuva, sa masikati nemanheru.
y-m-78-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Zvose kuchengeta nekugadzirisa zvinoshanda kana pane chikonzero.
y-m-78-01.s.s3.model.2: Kutonga kwangu kwekutanga kunodzikira. Nezviitiko 20 chete, musiyano wemedian we maminetsi 3 ungangova njodzi. Ndinoda kuona data rema odha emwedzi yakati wandei.

y-m-78-02.title: Kana huremu huchichinja, kurongeka kunochinja here?
y-m-78-02.topic: Weighted average: mamakisi akashandurwa anochinja nehuremu
y-m-78-02.goal: Simbisa kuti kurongeka kwemamakisi akashandurwa evadzidzi vaviri kunogona kuchinja zvichienderana nehuremu, wana huremu hwakati wandei hunogutsa mamiriro ese akapiwa, uye utaurirane nezvekururamisira kwekusarudza huremu.
y-m-78-02.material:
Giredhi remwedzi mitanhatu yechidzidzo chimwe rinowanikwa nekuwanza mamakisi e 'written test' ne 'performance assessment' nehuremu hwakagadzikana uye kuawedzera, akashandurwa kuita mamakisi kubva ku 100. Kana huremu hwe written test i p%, huremu hwe performance assessment i q%, uye p+q=100. Ongororo dzese mbiri dzinobva ku 100.

| | Makisi e written test | Makisi e performance |
|---|---|---|
| Minseo | 72 | 96 |
| Doyun | 94 | 70 |

Fungidzira kuti mamakisi evadzidzi vaviri haachinji. Huremu hahusati hwasarudzwa.
y-m-78-02.thinking.0: Kuwana mitengo yakati wandei inogutsa mamiriro akati wandei panguva imwechete
y-m-78-02.thinking.1: Kutarisa mhedzisiro yehuremu kumudzidzi mumwe nemumwe zvakaparadzana
y-m-78-02.thinking.2: Kuongorora kuti sei zvinofanira kutanga zvasarudzwa
y-m-78-02.prereq.1: Zvinoreva percentages, nekuverenga ne decimals nema fractions
y-m-78-02.prereq.2: Chokwadi chekuti giredhi rechidzidzo rinosarudzwa nekubatanidza mamakisi eongororo akati wandei nehuremu hwakagadzikana
y-m-78-02.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukakwidza huremu hwe written test (semuenzaniso, kubva ku 40% kusvika ku 60%), unotarisira mamakisi akashandurwa evadzidzi vaviri kuchinja sei?
y-m-78-02.s.s1.hint.0: Wana mamakisi akashandurwa evadzidzi vaviri kune p=40 ne p=60 uye uanyore padivi pedivi.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti makisi emudzidzi mumwe nemumwe anofamba munzira ipi painokura p.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.o.a: Chero huremu hwe written test hwachinjwa sei, kurongeka kwemamakisi akashandurwa evadzidzi vaviri kunogara kwakafanana.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.r.a: Kuti kurongeka kugare kwakafanana, mudzidzi mumwe aifanira kuva akakwira pamamakisi ese maviri. Vadzidzi vaviri ava vane mamakisi avo akakwirira pangororo dzakasiyana.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.o.b: Kana ukakwidza huremu hwe written test, mamakisi akashandurwa evadzidzi vese vaviri anokwira.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.r.b: Huremu hahugadzire mamakisi; hunochinja kuti makisi ripi rinorema zvakawanda. Mudzidzi ane makisi akaderera kudivi rimwe anogona chaizvo kudzikira.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.o.c: Minseo, ane musiyano mukuru pakati pemamakisi, anogara achishandurwa kuva akakwirira pasinei nehuremu.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.r.c: Musiyano mukuru pakati pemamakisi maviri hauiti kuti makisi akashandurwa ave akakwirira nguva dzose. Chinokosha i kuti makisi ripi rinorema.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.o.d: Kana ukakwidza huremu hwe written test, Doyun anowana uye Minseo anorasikirwa.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.r.d: Wakaratidza nzira: mudzidzi ane makisi e written akakwirira anowana uye ane makisi akadzika anorasikirwa. Unogona kuwana nekuverenga kubva pa percent ipi kurongeka kunochinja chaizvo.
y-m-78-02.s.s1.explain: Painokura huremu hwe written p, Doyun (94), ane makisi e written akakwirira, anowana, uye Minseo (96), ane makisi e performance akakwirira, anorasikirwa. P apo mamakisi akashandurwa evadzidzi vaviri anova akaenzana i anenge 54.2% (72p+96q=94p+70q, p+q=100).
y-m-78-02.s.s2.prompt:
Isa huremu 2 hwakasiyana hunogutsa mamiriro ese anotevera. (written p%, performance q%, ese ma integers)
① p+q=100
② Zvose written ne performance i 20% kana kupfuura
③ Makisi akashandurwa aMinseo i 85 kana kupfuura
④ Makisi akashandurwa aDoyun i 80 kana kupfuura
y-m-78-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawana nenzira yakafanana range ye p inogutsa ③ oga, wobva wawana range inogutsa ④ oga, uye utarise kwainopindirana.
y-m-78-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza p imwe uye uverenge mamakisi akashandurwa evadzidzi vaviri, wobva wachinja p ne 1 uye uenzanise kuti mamakisi anofamba munzira ipi.
y-m-78-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Huremu hwega hwega i integer 20% kana kupfuura.
y-m-78-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Huremu hwega hwega hunofanira kuva integer 20 kana kupfuura.

y-m-78-02.s.s3.prompt: Tonga kana zvakanaka kuti chikoro chiise huremu nenzira iyi, 'kugadzirisa huremu mushure mekuona mamakisi evadzidzi vaviri'.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa zvakare kwakashandiswa mamakisi evadzidzi muna ① kusvika ④.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti unofanira kutsanangura sei kuti chiyero chinoiswa rini uye chinoshanda kuna ani kana uchida kutaura kuti chiyero 'chakaenzana'.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.o.a: Sarudza huremu mushure mekunge mamakisi abuda kuti mudzidzi waunoda awane makisi akakwirira.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.r.a: Kana ukasarudza chiyero mushure mekuona mhedzisiro, chiyero chinova che mudzidzi mumwe chete.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.o.b: Sarudza huremu pamberi petest uye uhushandise zvakaenzana kuvadzidzi vese.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.r.b: Wakaratidza kuti chiyero chinoiswa pamberi pemamakisi uye chinoshandiswa zvakafanana kune wese.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.o.c: Shandisa kumudzidzi mumwe nemumwe zvakaparadzana huremu hunopa mudzidzi iyeye makisi ake akakwirira.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.r.c: Kana chiyero chakasiyana kumudzidzi mumwe nemumwe, haugone kuenzanisa mamakisi akashandurwa emumwe nemumwe.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.o.d: Huremu hahukanganisi mamakisi akashandurwa, saka zvakanaka chero hwasarudzwa sei.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.r.d: Sezvawakaverenga iwe pachako, mamakisi akashandurwa nekurongeka zvinochinja zvichienderana nehuremu.
y-m-78-02.s.s3.explain: Wakasimbisa kuti huremu hunochinja mamakisi akashandurwa nekurongeka. Saka hunofanira kuiswa mamakisi asati abuda, kuti huenderane nechinangwa cheongororo, uye huchishandiswa zvakafanana kune wese. Mubasa iri, 'kuwana huremu hunogutsa mamiriro' yaiva maitiro ekunzwisisa kuti huremu hunokanganisa sei mhedzisiro.

y-m-78-03.title: Musiyano wemapoinzi 12 nemusiyano wemapoinzi 18: ndeupi mukuru?
y-m-78-03.topic: Kuenzanisa mamakisi etests dzakasiyana uchishandisa standard deviation
y-m-78-03.goal: Enzanisa mamakisi etests dzakasiyana kwete nemusiyano kubva pamean chete asi pamwe chete nekupararira kwawo (standard deviation), uye utaure fungidziro dzinoita kuti kuenzanisa uku kuvimbike.
y-m-78-03.material:
Hayun akawana 82 muChiKorea na 74 mumath pa tests dzegiredhi rimwechete. Mhedzisiro yegiredhi rese i inotevera (tests dzese dzinobva ku 100).

| | Makisi aHayun | Mean yegiredhi | Standard deviation (kuti mamakisi akapararira zvakadini kutenderedza mean) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Korean | 82 | 70 | 6 |
| Math | 74 | 56 | 12 |

Hayun anofunga, 'MuMath ndiri mapoinzi 18 pamusoro pemean uye muKorean mapoinzi 12, saka ndakaita zvirinani muMath.'
y-m-78-03.thinking.0: Kuenzanisa mitengo yema scales akasiyana nechiyero chimwechete
y-m-78-03.thinking.1: Kuwana mutsetse mumaitiro apo chiyero chekuenzanisa chinoshandiswa zvisizvo
y-m-78-03.prereq.1: Zvinoreva mean ne standard deviation (kuti data rakapararira zvakadini kutenderedza mean)
y-m-78-03.s.s1.prompt: Hayun anoti, 'Ndiri mapoinzi 18 pamusoro pemean muMath, saka Math ndicho chidzidzo chandakaita zvirinani zvikuru.' Kana uchienzanisa nzvimbo mukati megiredhi, kutonga kupi kwakakodzera zvikuru?
y-m-78-03.s.s1.hint.0: Pachidzidzo chimwe nechimwe, wana kuti musiyano kubva pamean i ka kangani ye standard deviation, uye uenzanise.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti kupararira kwemamakisi kutenderedza mean kunochinja sei zvinoreva mapoinzi 12 nemapoinzi 18 akafanana.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.o.a: Korean (82), apo makisi pachawo akakwirira, ndicho chidzidzo chakaitwa zvirinani.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.r.a: Zvinoreva makisi akakwirira zvinoenderana nekuti test yaiva nyore kana yakaoma. Unofanira kutarisa mutengo wakaenzaniswa nemean yegiredhi.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.o.b: Math (mapoinzi 18), apo musiyano kubva pamean wakakura, ndicho chidzidzo chakaitwa zvirinani.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.r.b: Wakaenzanisa misiyano yemamakisi sezvayakaita. MuMath mamakisi akapararira zvakawanda, saka mapoinzi 18 anoreva chimwe chinhu chakasiyana nemapoinzi 12 eKorean.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.o.c: Kushandisa hukuru hwe standard deviation seyuniti uye kutarisa kuti ari mangani kure nemean, Korean i panzvimbo yakakwira.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakachinjira kudhuri rinoyerwa nekupararira kwedata uye wakaenzanisa. Wakaita mayuniti emamakisi akafanana wobva waenzanisa.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.o.d: Hatizivi kunetsa kwetest kana chimiro chekugoverwa kwemamakisi, saka hatigone kutonga kuti ndeipi iri panzvimbo yakakwira.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.r.d: Uku i maitiro anongwarira ekuda kusimbisa chimiro chekugoverwa. Zvisinei, sezvo mean ne standard deviation zvapiwa, unogona kutanga watarisa kana pane kuenzanisa kwaunogona kuita nazvo.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.explain: MuKorean, makisi i mapoinzi 12 pamusoro pemean uye standard deviation i 6, saka i 2 standard deviations pamusoro pemean. MuMath, i mapoinzi 18 pamusoro ne standard deviation ye 12, saka 1.5 standard deviations pamusoro. Saka mukati megiredhi, Korean i panzvimbo yakakwira. Zvinewo musoro kurega kutonga uchisaziva kunyange chimiro chekugoverwa.
y-m-78-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kutonga kunongwarira kwekusasimbisa nzvimbo usingazivi chimiro chekugoverwa nehunhu hwetest kunoshandawo. Zvisinei, unofanira kusimbisa kuti pane ruzivo rwaunogona kuenzanisa nemean ne standard deviation chete.
